contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($5690.79) on the Summary Page (PDF p2, foliated 'Page 1 of 4'), which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 5690.79 AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' 5690.79 — three independent printed figures, all agreeing
contributions.detail: Schedule A (PDF p3) carries 17 written entries in a 17-line grid. SIXTEEN of them are cash and sum to exactly 5,690.79: 50.00+25.00+125.00+200.00+500.00+20.00+50.00+647.22+850.00+100.00+100.00+2500.00+300.00+100.00+100.00+23.57 = 5690.79. The SEVENTEENTH written entry (line 16, Dave Broberg 2/21/2018) prints '$50 (In Kind)' in the amount cell and is the filer's own in-kind marking; it is published as a row with in_kind=true but is EXCLUDED from the anchor, because the Column A contribution cell on this family states the CASH figure. Gross sum of all 17 published rows is 5,740.79 (this is the figure checkrec.py reports); cash-only is 5,690.79 and that is what the three printed figures state. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 5690.79 — identical to Column A because this is the filer's only report of the cycle ('30 Days after withdraw or elimination', 05/09/2018), so period equals year-to-date here and the two scopes cannot be distinguished on this document; the PER-PERIOD Column A cell is the promoted anchor per the utah per-period regime and it is what closed. The summary ladder is internally consistent: line 3 beginning 30.23 + line 4 5690.79 = line 5 subtotal 5721.02; 5721.02 - line 6 5548.02 = line 7 close 173.00.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($5548.02) on the Summary Page, equal to the printed 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' 5548.02 printed on BOTH Schedule B sheets, and to the sum of the two printed page subtotals (4572.10 on PDF p4 + 975.92 on PDF p5)
expenditures.detail: TWO Schedule B sheets. PDF p4 (foliated 'Page 3 of 4') carries 17 entries filling all 17 lines: 112.09+17.12+42.00+16.02+33.69+16.02+600.00+500.00+16.75+42.00+30.98+50.10+9.21+60.19+228.41+7.62+2789.90 = 4,572.10 = its own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 4572.10 to the cent. PDF p5 (foliated 'Page 4 of 4') carries 4 entries on lines 1-4 of a 17-line grid: 228.66+49.50+647.22+50.54 = 975.92 = its own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 975.92 to the cent. 4572.10 + 975.92 = 5,548.02 = the printed cycle/period total on both sheets = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell. Column B YTD prints the same 5548.02 (single-report cycle) and is never summed as an increment. Neither Schedule B sheet prints or marks any in-kind item, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions are identical on this side and both close at 5548.02.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'Karen Ellingson', party 'Republican', Office Seeking printed as 'County Commissioner' with NO SEAT LETTER — index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat A' from the channel and that seat is NOT inferred or confirmed from this document. index.csv names no candidate for this row; the page face governs. Report type: the INTERIM box '30 Days after withdraw or elimination' is the one ticked (the index period label 'Out at Convention - Ellingson' is the channel's own wording, not the form's). Report date 05/09/2018 on the cover and on all four inner sheets; clerk's red 'Date received' stamp reads 5-10-18 4:58 pm. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS AN HONEST BLANK: neither 'Yes' nor 'No' is ticked, yet the 'Date of Report' blank that follows 'Yes' carries 05/09/2018 — transcribed as the state it is in, not adjudicated. FORM STOCK (§G5/§H5): the cover is the county-only title 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)' and the four inner sheets are GENUINELY 2018-DATED — strap-lined '2018 County Candidate' on the summary and both Schedule B sheets, and '2018 County CandidateS' (plural) on the Schedule A sheet, i.e. two 2018 wordings inside one filing. No 2016 leftover stock here. Schedule B's payee column is headed 'Provider/Vendor' (the fourth vocabulary, §H5) and there is NO Purpose column on either Schedule B sheet. DOCUMENT SHAPE: 5 PDF pages = cover (unfoliated) + summary 'Page 1 of 4' + Schedule A 'Page 2 of 4' + Schedule B 'Page 3 of 4' + Schedule B 'Page 4 of 4'; the foliation excludes the cover and states the document is complete as filed, and the pdfinfo count agrees. The summary page IS at p2 here, but it was located by its printed 'SUMMARY PAGE' heading, not by ordinal. GRID: 17 usable data lines per sheet (§H1) — Schedule A used all 17, Schedule B p4 used all 17, Schedule B p5 used 4. Entries are machine-typed; only the signature is handwritten. ROW-INDEX TRAPS SCREENED: the filer did not skip line 1 on any sheet (the §A1 first-entry crop rendered the recorded row-1 figure directly under the 'Amount' header on all three), no banner, voided or continuation line appears, the §B5 one-past control rendered the printed page subtotal on pp3-4 and an empty cell on p5 (no ledger below the last rule, §F1), and every band that rowbands.py returned at ~2x pitch was split and BOTH halves crop-proved separately (§F6/§H3) — no doubled band was carried, and no shortfall had to be explained. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: columns assigned by CONTENT and confirmed against the printed headings on each sheet — dates in the Date column, personal/organisation names in the Name-of-Contributor and Provider/Vendor columns, mailing lines in the address column, money in the Amount column; no inversion of the §F2/§G3 kind occurs anywhere on this filing. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT one of the county's redacted publications — every donor and vendor mailing line is printed in the clear — and it was reduced to city/state at read time, with nothing beyond that written into any field or note.
